text: Thank you for the information. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure (likely due to congenital heart disease).

The clinical triad of tachypnea, hepatomegaly, and pitting edema in a 3-year-old without fever strongly suggests heart failure rather than infection or liver failure. I will now request an Echocardiogram to assess cardiac structure and function.
